title: Dividend Administration Terms for Whole Life Insurance: Dividend Accumulations Applied When Reduced Paid-Up Insurance Is Elected
content:
**Product:** Whole Life Insurance — Ashgrove participating tiers holding dividends on deposit.

## Terms

When the owner elects reduced paid-up insurance, the whole dividend accumulation deposit is withdrawn and applied with the cash value to buy the reduced paid-up insurance, as one accumulation withdrawal entry. The withdrawal carries interest on the deposit for the part of the current policy year that ends on the date the election takes effect, which is the paid-to date. No money is sent to the owner.

| Element | Effect |
|---|---|
| Occasion | The owner's election of reduced paid-up insurance on a policy holding dividend accumulations |
| Amount | The whole deposit, with interest for the part of the current policy year ending on the paid-to date |
| Entry | One accumulation withdrawal entry on the policy's activity history |
| Afterwards | The policy shows no dividend accumulations; the amount withdrawn goes, with the cash value, toward the reduced paid-up insurance |

## Invocation: `withdraw_election_accumulations_2818c877`

**Capability.** Withdraws the whole dividend accumulation deposit of one Ashgrove whole life policy so that it is applied, together with the policy's cash value, to the reduced paid-up insurance the owner is electing. One call books a single accumulation withdrawal entry dated today for the amount given and closes the policy's dividend accumulation balance to zero; no money is sent to the owner.

**How it is invoked.** This is an agent-side tool. Unlock it with `unlock_agent_discoverable_tool`, then call it with `call_agent_discoverable_tool`.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `whole_policy_id` | The reference number of the whole life policy whose accumulation deposit is withdrawn, as returned by the whole life policy lookup for the verified owner | Identifier, as recorded |
| `withdrawal_amount` | The total withdrawn from the accumulation deposit, including any interest for the part of the policy year it carries | US dollars, 2 decimal places, rounded half up to the cent before it is passed |

**Return.** A receipt with `withdrawal_id` (the reference of the new withdrawal entry), `whole_policy_id`, `amount_withdrawn` (2 decimal places), `withdrawal_date` (YYYY-MM-DD) and `accumulation_balance_after` (always 0.00 once the deposit is closed). A receipt carrying a `withdrawal_id` means the withdrawal was booked.
